Verse baseline glue (ULSBS).description: Set total nominal lyric baseline glue using nonnegative capital-A height scalars (natural, stretch, shrink). Apply after font setup; values are illustrative, not defaults.

Inter-verse glue (ULSBS).description: Set inter-verse glue using nonnegative capital-A height scalars (natural, stretch, shrink). Apply after font setup; values are illustrative, not defaults.

Verse baseline-to-top clearance (ULSBS).description: Set the minimum clearance from the preceding lyric baseline to the next line's top (default 3.5pt).

Minimum lyric-line clearance (ULSBS).description: Set minimum edge-to-edge clearance between lyric lines in the current scope (default 1pt).

Read verse spacing scalar (ULSBS).description: Read the stored scalar for a relative spacing calculation; this does not set spacing.

Variant availability class option (ULSBS.description: Declare literal availability in the main document's class options. Keep default; omitting the option means default-only.

Local feature visibility request (ULSBS).description: Set a grouped local visibility request; true cannot override book permission. notes means inline pitches; scores means whole scores.

Variant identity branches (ULSBS).description: Branch on immutable variant identity, not feature visibility.

Effective musical visibility branches (U.description: Branch on effective chords OR inline pitches OR whole scores in this scope; excludes beats and measures.

Chord definition (ULSBS).description: Insert \[ ... ] (ULSBS). Place chord names and melody blocks within this.

Chord definition with melody block (ULSB.description: Insert a chord definition with a melody block: primary[;secondary][ @ offset].

Zero-advance chord definition with melod.description: Insert melody layers with zero advance; a following chord keeps its natural width.

Unmemorized chord definition with melody.description: Insert a melody block excluded from chord memorization.

Secondary melody position (ULSBS).description: Set the secondary melody position in the current TeX scope; same overlays the primary lane.

Primary melody position (ULSBS).description: Set the primary melody position in the current TeX scope; normal is the default.

Melody style mapping (ULSBS).description: Set the primary/secondary visual style mapping in the current TeX scope.

Lane-aware annotation spacing (ULSBS).description: Opt out of lane-aware annotation spacing, which is on by default.

Scaled lyric space (ULSBS).description: Insert a breakable lyric space, including between adjacent measure bars. Omit the multiplier for one normal space.

Centered continuation hyphen (ULSBS).description: Center one hyphen in a lyric continuation gap, including across an intervening annotation.

begin{ulSongs} ... end{ulSongs} (ULSBS).description: Insert ulSongs with its required index list (empty to collect no indices). Songs must be within ulSongs environments.

Select songs by ID (ULSBS).description: Preferred selection by stable song IDs. Use in the preamble or between ulSongs blocks.

Select songs by printed number (ULSBS).description: Select by printed number. Prefer ulIncludeOnlySongIds when numbers may change or repeat.

Selection numbering (ULSBS).description: Keep source numbers (default) or number selected songs in print order from 1. Use in the preamble.

Set a selected song's printed key (ULSBS.description: Transpose an ID-selected song to this tonic while preserving its major/minor mode.

Tag-definition file (ULSBS).description: Preamble-only tag filename setter. An explicit missing file fails without default fallback.

Title index declaration (ULSBS).description: Declare a title index with a custom identifier and filename stem in the preamble.

Author index declaration (ULSBS).description: Declare a generated author index with a custom identifier and filename stem in the preamble.

Tag index declaration (ULSBS).description: Declare a tag index with a custom identifier and filename stem in the preamble.

begin{passage} ... end{passage} (ULSBS).description: Insert passage with an optional language code and a required title argument (which may be empty).

Alternate passage (ULSBS).description: Insert an alternate-style passage. The star follows the opening environment delimiter; language is optional and title braces are required.
